title: Miso cod with greens and rice
toddlerSplit: Flake the toddlers' cod over plain rice before the miso glaze goes on — miso is very salty for under-3s. Give them broccoli tips steamed soft, cut small.
steps: Rice on first: rinse, then simmer covered for 12 minutes and leave it alone.
Heat the oven grill. Mix the miso, grated ginger and sesame oil into a loose paste.
Sit the cod on a lined tray. Set aside the toddlers' portions unglazed, then brush the rest with miso.
Grill 8 minutes until the fish flakes and the glaze is bubbling.
Steam or microwave the broccoli 4 minutes while the fish cooks.
Serve over rice, scattered with sliced spring onions.
